semiconductor_relevance: High — Ample Semiconductors specializes in VLSI design and embedded systems, which are critical components in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Ample Semiconductors Private Limited, established in 2022 in Bengaluru, India, offers innovative solutions in VLSI design, embedded systems, and AI/ML services. The company focuses on empowering clients with advanced semiconductor technologies to maintain a competitive edge in the market.

regional_presence.India: The company is based in Bengaluru, focusing on the semiconductor design sector.
